description: Add 'defer tx.Rollback()' after checking the error from 's.db.BeginTx()' to ensure the transaction is rolle...
evidence: BeginTx is an ownership-transfer factory: after successful database/sql BeginTx it immediately returns a storeTx embedding the live sql.Tx. Deferring rollback inside the factory would invalidate the returned transaction. Exhaustive AST/source audit found 38 production acquisition sites: 35 immediate deferred-rollback consumers, 3 ownership-transfer factories (BeginTx, tryBeginRulePublication, beginRulePublication). Publication lock failure explicitly rolls back before retry/return; all 5 final publication consumers defer rollback. No uncovered transaction lifetime observed. New real-database regressions cover commit, early-error return, panic unwinding and cancellation. This is a Reliability finding requiring a Sonar false-positive decision, NOT a code-fixed leak.
review_reason_zh: BeginTx 是交付活交易所有權的 factory；在 factory 內 defer rollback 會使回傳的交易立即失效。需確認所有最終消費端負責 commit／deferred rollback，再進行服務端審查。新增 early return／panic／cancel 邊界測試，而非破壞所有權契約。

description: Make sure the "PATH" variable only contains fixed, unwriteable directories.
evidence: Both Go harnesses spawn a validated canonical absolute executable rather than child_process PATH search. Resolver rejects relative overrides/PATH entries; executable and every ancestor must be root/current-euid owned. File cannot be group/world writable; writable ancestors require trusted-owner sticky protection over their already-validated child. PI_GO_BINARY/GOROOT supported; Windows retains explicit-path resolution under OS ACL trust. Tests reject writable grandparent and accept trusted sticky ancestor without executing test markers. Developer/current-user/root compromise remains outside this boundary.
